_note: Curated growth opportunities beyond full-time jobs. Researched 2026-11-07 — always confirm dates on the official link. deadline: ISO date, 'rolling', or 'expected:<YYYY-MM>' for cycles not yet announced. Add your own entries freely.

items.title: Mercor — AI expert / SWE / ML contract work
items.payoff: USD $14–$150/hr seen on listings; India SWE listings ~$14–30/hr, expert ML/coding eval roles much higher
items.action: Profile exists — now apply to 3–5 listings/week tagged Software Engineer, ML Engineer, Coding/LLM evaluation, Quantum/Physics expert. Redo the AI interview if your score was low; it gates everything.

items.title: Upwork — RAG / LangGraph / FastAPI gigs
items.payoff: $20–60/hr once you have 3–5 reviews; first 2 gigs may be cheap
items.action: Niche profile: 'RAG & AI agent engineer (LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS)'. Bid on small fixed-price RAG/chatbot jobs to build reviews.

items.title: Outlier / Alignerr / Turing / micro1 — coding & STEM AI-training
items.payoff: Part-time USD hourly; flexible, good side income while on GRF
items.action: Apply to 2 of these as backup to Mercor; pick C++/Python coding and physics/quantum domains.

items.title: Toptal / Arc.dev — vetted remote dev
items.payoff: $30–80/hr remote contracts
items.action: Apply after ~2 months of DSA grind — their screens are DSA + live coding.

items.title: Google Student Researcher 2027 (Remote, India) — DeepMind/Research/Cloud
items.payoff: Paid research placement at Google; Quantum Information Science is a listed area
items.action: Only if you are currently enrolled in a degree (BTech/MS/PhD). If your GRF is non-degree you're not eligible — re-check after PhD admission.

items.title: Kaggle: Google Quantum AI — Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation ($150k)
items.payoff: $150,000 prize pool; Google Quantum AI visibility — uniquely fits your Qiskit + C++ + ML profile
items.action: TOP PRIORITY. Join this week, read the rules/baseline, aim for a public notebook + top-10% finish. Even a bronze medal is a resume line no other fresher has.

items.title: Kaggle: Google — Gemma 4 Developer Agent Competition ($75k)
items.payoff: $75,000; builds a shippable agent project (LangGraph/agentic skills)
items.action: ~3.5 weeks left. Build a focused agent + writeup; doubles as portfolio project.

items.title: Kaggle: Name That LLM ($50k)
items.payoff: $50,000; LLM fine-tuning practice (your QLoRA/DPO skills)
items.action: Second competition only if time allows after the quantum one.

items.title: NUS Singapore — funded PhD, Quantum Computing + AI (CS dept route)
items.payoff: Fully funded PhD at a top-10 CS school in exactly your intersection (quantum + ML)
items.action: Email the PI this week with CV + 1-paragraph research fit; ask your IIT Delhi supervisor for a letter now.

items.title: SINGA scholarship (A*STAR + NUS/NTU/SUTD/SMU), Aug 2027 intake
items.payoff: Full tuition + S$2,200+/month for up to 4 years
items.action: Confirm 2027 deadline on A*STAR site; needs 2 referees — ask now.

items.title: IIT Delhi / IISc PhD — July 2027 cycle
items.payoff: Funded PhD in India; as current IIT D GRF you have an inside track with your lab
items.action: Jan 2027 windows closed (Oct). Ask your supervisor about direct PhD conversion; register for GATE/check JRF eligibility.

items.title: PMRF (Prime Minister's Research Fellowship), Dec-2026 cycle
items.payoff: ₹70k–80k/month + research grant — rivals a 10–12 LPA job
items.action: Only via institute nomination after PhD admission; ask IIT D PMRF coordinator if lateral entry applies to you.

items.title: ELLIS PhD Program (Europe, ML) — next cycle
items.payoff: Funded ML PhD with top European labs
items.action: 2027 call closed 31 Oct 2026; diarise for next Oct and build a paper by then.

items.title: Microsoft Research India — Research Fellow (2027 cohort)
items.payoff: 1–2 yr paid research role at MSR India; top springboard to PhD at CMU/Stanford or to industry
items.action: You're the exact profile (BTech, <3 yrs out, research exp). Prepare resume + 1 strong letter now; interest form opens ~spring.

items.title: Microsoft CoreAI (FoSSE) Research Fellow — rolling, Bengaluru
items.payoff: Paid research fellow role at Microsoft
items.action: Email CV + letter to fosse-hiring@microsoft.com (per posting) — do this week.

items.title: IBM Qiskit Advocate — keep status active / go for mentor projects
items.payoff: IBM Quantum network, mentorship program, conference invites
items.action: You're already an Advocate — join the Advocate Mentorship Program and contribute to Qiskit repos.

items.title: Google Summer of Code 2027 (Qiskit / ML orgs)
items.payoff: $1,500–6,600 stipend + strong signal; open to non-students (beginners in OSS)
items.action: Start contributing to your target org (Qiskit, PyTorch, OpenCV) in Dec–Feb so your proposal is pre-validated.

items.title: AWS Solutions Architect – Associate (SAA-C03)
items.payoff: Credible cloud signal for SDE + MLOps roles
items.action: Self-set deadline: book the exam for mid-Jan so prep has a hard stop.

items.title: QpiAI (Bangalore) — AI + quantum computing
items.payoff: India-based; quantum + ML is your exact combo. Best realistic quantum job target.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.

items.title: QNu Labs (Bangalore) — quantum-safe security / QKD / PQC
items.payoff: India-based; your HCLTech quantum-security internship maps directly.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.

items.title: Riverlane (Cambridge, UK) — quantum error correction
items.payoff: QEC decoders = C++ + ML + performance work. Abroad/visa; aim for internship or post-PhD.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.

items.title: Classiq (Tel Aviv) — quantum software platform
items.payoff: Software-first quantum co; has community/advocate programs worth joining.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.

items.title: Quantum Machines (Tel Aviv) — control systems for quantum hardware
items.payoff: Python/C++ control-stack roles; abroad.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.

items.title: QuEra (Boston) — neutral-atom computers
items.payoff: Open-source Bloqade (Julia/Python) — contribute to get noticed.
items.action: Find 1 engineer + 1 researcher on LinkedIn; send a short note referencing your Qiskit Advocate status + the Google Quantum AI Kaggle notebook (once published). Ask about software/ML roles, not hardware.
